name: pitlane
description: Save, re-check and read car listings on your Pitlane watchlist.

tools.name: save_listing
tools.description: Add a listing or record a re-check of a saved one.

tools.name: mark_listing_removed
tools.description: Record that a saved listing's ad is gone.

tools.name: list_due_rechecks
tools.description: Saved listings due for a re-check, oldest first.

tools.name: report_check_failed
tools.description: Record a re-check that could not read the page.

tools.name: list_listings
tools.description: List the watchlist with tiers, status and prices.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full details, price history and photos of one listing.

api_url.title: Pitlane API URL
api_url.description: The Convex deployment's HTTP Actions URL, ending in .convex.site.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: A pit_… token created with tokens:create.
